sn35.103:1.1: uddako sudaṃ bhikkhave rāmaputto evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati.
sn35.103:1.6: taṃ kho panetaṃ bhikkhave uddako rāmaputto avedagūyeva samāno vedagū’smīti bhāsati, asabbajīyeva samāno sabbajī’smīti bhāsati, apalikhataṃ yeva gaṇḍamūlaṃ palikhataṃyeva gaṇḍamūlanti bhāsati.
sn35.103:1.7: idha kho taṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu sammāvadamāno vadeyya.
sn35.103:2.2: yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhu channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti,
sn35.103:2.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu vedagū hoti.
sn35.103:3.2: yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhu channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādāya vimutto hoti.
sn35.103:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbajī hoti.
sn35.103:4.1: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu no apalikhataṃ gaṇḍamūlaṃ palikhataṃ hoti?
sn35.103:4.2: gaṇḍoti kho, bhikkhave imassetaṃ cātummahābhūtikassa kāyassa adhivacanaṃ mātāpettikasambhavassa odanakummāsūpacayassa aniccucchādana parimaddana bhedana viddhaṃsanadhammassa.
sn35.103:4.4: yato kho bhikkhave, bhikkhuno taṇhā pahīnā hoti ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
sn35.103:4.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno apalikhataṃ gaṇḍamūlaṃ palikhataṃ hoti.
sn35.103:5.1: uddako sudaṃ bhikkhave, rāmaputto evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati:
sn35.103:5.6: taṃ kho panetaṃ bhikkhave, uddako rāmaputto avedagūyeva samāno vedagū’smīti bhāsati, asabbajīyeva samāno sabbajīsmīti bhāsati. apalikhataṃyeva gaṇḍamūlaṃ palikhataṃyeva gaṇḍamūlanti bhāsati.
sn35.103:5.7: idha kho taṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammāvadamāno vadeyya:
